quarterly_data.signal: Capacity prepayments (H1 2026 reviewed financial statements): temporary receipts from customers - which TSMC defines as 'payments made by customers to the Company to retain the Company's capacity', later refunded or offset against accounts receivable by mutual consent once the agreements' terms are satisfied - stood at NT$234,225,146 thousand at June 30, 2026, versus NT$189,858,211 thousand at December 31, 2025 and NT$221,915,273 thousand at June 30, 2025; the noncurrent portion rose to NT$92,372,004 thousand from NT$43,298,936 thousand at December 31, 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: customer capacity-retention payments NT$234,225,146 thousand at June 30, 2026 (December 31, 2025: NT$189,858,211 thousand)

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 revenue detail in NT dollars (H1 2026 reviewed financial statements): 2-nanometer wafer revenue NT$31,934,248 thousand (none in Q2 2025); 3-nanometer NT$320,558,574 thousand (Q2 2025: NT$187,252,107 thousand); 5-nanometer NT$350,112,503 thousand (Q2 2025: NT$289,669,221 thousand); total wafer revenue NT$1,073,707,321 thousand. High Performance Computing platform revenue was NT$830,369,159 thousand versus NT$561,155,353 thousand in Q2 2025, and revenue from United States-headquartered customers NT$970,894,218 thousand versus NT$694,211,968 thousand.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 2026: 2-nanometer NT$31,934,248 thousand; 3-nanometer NT$320,558,574 thousand; HPC NT$830,369,159 thousand (Q2 2025: NT$561,155,353 thousand)

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity build-out spending (H1 2026 cash flow statement): payments for acquisition of property, plant and equipment were NT$846,764,746 thousand in the first six months of 2026 versus NT$628,052,531 thousand a year earlier, on PP&E additions of NT$962,017,661 thousand; payables to contractors and equipment suppliers rose to NT$290,850,560 thousand at June 30, 2026 from NT$177,730,306 thousand at December 31, 2025.
